name: Second-Order Chamfer Distance
definition: A supervised loss function using quadratic approximation of point-point distance incorporating local surface curvature to measure distance between a predicted mesh vertex and the ground truth surface.
summary: Second-Order Chamfer Distance is a supervised geometric loss that measures mesh discrepancy using a quadratic approximation incorporating local principal curvatures, unlike standard Chamfer Distance which relies solely on Euclidean point-to-point distances.
